copy.tagline_en: Learn and apply LLM tuning patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are studying or practicing LLM tuning methods.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会根据任务类型自动调整 max_tokens、temperature、top_p 等参数，并在定理证明时先要求写出证明计划再生成策略。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 进行定理证明、代码生成或创意探索时触发。

say.text: 帮我证明这个定理，先写证明计划。
say.note: Claude 会先输出证明计划再给出 Lean 4 策略。

say.text: 写一个 Python 函数，temperature 用 0.3。
say.note: Claude 会使用代码生成参数配置。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically adjusts parameters like max_tokens, temperature, and top_p based on task type, and for theorem proving, it first requests a proof plan before generating tactics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to do theorem proving, code generation, or creative exploration tasks.

say_en.text: Prove this theorem, first write a proof plan.
say_en.note: Claude will output a proof plan then suggest Lean 4 tactics.

say_en.text: Write a Python function with temperature 0.3.
say_en.note: Claude will use code generation parameter settings.
